articles.title: Percy Jackson and the Olympians Season 3, Episodes 1 & 2 Recap and Review
articles.summary: The first two episodes of Percy Jackson and the Olympians Season 3 debut on Disney+ on Friday, November 20. The premiere of Percy Jackson Season 3 marks the first time an adaptation has made it past the second novel in Rick Riordan's series.
body: The first two episodes act as the setup for the main quest of Season 3. We get a proper introduction to Thalia as a key player, as well as new characters like Nico, Bianca, Artemis, Apollo, and Atlas. The premiere largely succeeds in its effort to kick off the story, and by the end of Episode 2 I found myself genuinely excited for more.

Walker Scobell has been a delightful Percy Jackson since Season 1, but he's only gotten better with experience. Whenever Percy is interacting with his friends or the gods themselves, all of the moving parts of the story seem to click in place. Tamara Smart also makes for a great Thalia, acting as the perfect counterbalance to Percy. These are two equally powerful demigods who are learning to deal with each other's existence, and the tension definitely comes through. The most engaging moments of the first two episodes are when the son of Poseidon and the daughter of Zeus find themselves at odds—which is pretty much constantly.
points: The first two episodes of Percy Jackson and the Olympians Season 3 debut on Disney+ on Friday, November 20.

articles.title: Ubisoft Says Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey Boosted Assassin's Creed Odyssey Sales
articles.summary: Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey sparked a fresh surge in back-catalog sales for 2018's Assassin's Creed Odyssey, Ubisoft has said. In its latest financial results briefing, the Assassin's Creed publisher noted how a "major summer movie" had "materially benefited" the continued sales of its…
body: Once again, Ubisoft used its financial update to praise the evergreen sales of its Assassin's Creed back catalog. Also, once again, it failed to provide any further detail on how last year's Assassin's Creed Shadows had fared. There's a sense that the long-awaited feudal Japan blockbuster has been a commercial disappointment for Ubisoft, and it's been a while since we had any formal update on sales numbers. No further content for the game is on the way, either — even though 2020's Valhalla just got a New Game Plus mode.

Indeed, Shadows is not mentioned at all in the results, despite Ubisoft commenting on Odyssey, Valhalla (which also just passed 40 million players), and this year's Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced — the latter of which has clearly had a successful launch.

Ubisoft attributes an outperformance in its latest financial results to Resynced, which it describes as having been "among the industry's most successful Action-Adventure remakes." How did its launch compare to any all-new Assassin's Creed games? If it did surpass any of those, Ubisoft perhaps understandably isn't saying — but it's clear the game has been a hit.

articles.title: Total War: Warhammer 40,000 breaks the game into star system mini-campaigns, each with their own stories and objectives
articles.summary: There is perhaps nothing so brutal in a Total War game than getting an army full of elite units wiped out, and it appears that pain remains a factor in the upcoming Total War conversion of: Warhammer 40,000.
body: In an hour-long deep-dive livestream of Total War: Warhammer 40,000, developer Creative Assembly demonstrated the game in action, focusing initially on how armies navigate from planet to planet. Each star system apparently acts as a "contained campaign" you can hop between in the game.

The star system the stream focused on is Praevoss, a mid-sized collection of planets: three of which you can land on and fight on, while the others are smaller and unable to support your tactical warfare shenanigans. Once you're finished with a star system, you move on, carrying over units and unlocked skills.

"First and foremost, we want to represent the scale of the whole galaxy, which is just not possible on a single Total War map," Creative Assembly explained on the livestream. "You'd never be able to engage with it. Part of the point is to break this up a bit and allow us to have some more interesting and more bespoke narratives going on. So each of these star systems has a premise, has a narrative, has a specific setup, a specific start, [and] specific victory objectives that you've got to go and do."

articles.title: GTA 6 Players Find Red Dead Redemption Lore That Strongly Suggests Both Series Are Set in the Same Universe
articles.summary: Players have found lore in GTA 6 that strongly suggest the game takes place in the same universe as Rockstar’s Red Dead Redemption series, in a move that has excited fans about the prospect of a canon merger of timelines. Warning! Spoilers for GTA 6 and Red Dead Redemption 2 follow.
body: We’ve already found Arthur Morgan’s hat in GTA 6, but there’s another thing connecting the two games. A readable book found in Brian’s Marina in Key Lento has multiple references to Red Dead Redemption and its sequel. X / Twitter user GameRoll shared excerpts from the book online. The book is a chronicle of the life and death of Flaco Hernandez, a gunslinger Arthur Morgan hunts to his cabin by Cairn Lake in Grizzlies West during the The Noblest of Men, and a Woman stranger mission in RDR 2. The book itself could even be the chronicle you help Theodore Levin write by hunting down the gunslingers, or at least a modern reinterpretation of it.

It’s told from the viewpoint of Rust McCreary, an original character who doesn’t appear in either RDR game. In the book, he comes across the corpse of Hernandez in the snow at Cairn Lake, right where you leave him in the RDR 2 mission.

According to the book, Hernandez had a bullet hole right in the center of his forehead, so it’s canon that you can actually aim good. The book also references multiple locations, from New Austin to Armadillo and Blackwater.

articles.title: GTA 6 Actor Says Rockstar Made Their Non-Binary Character Unkillable
articles.summary: The state of Leonida has thousands of inhabitants, each one with their own story. One of them is Cygnus, not only Vice City's museum curator, but also the first non-binary character in Grand Theft Auto history.
body: Grand Theft Auto allows players to lead a hectic life of crime with lots of killing, shooting, and stealing, but of course, that doesn't reflect the values of the people who made it. Rose began filming for GTA 6 three years before its release and spent weeks on set. They shared that the set of Grand Theft Auto 6 was among the most inclusive and caring sets they'd worked on. However, at the time, they had no idea what they were filming for; to ensure confidentiality, they had to sign 17 different NDAs.

Considering that Jesse James Rose spent weeks filming, Cygnus is expected to play a role in the story of GTA 6 or a major sidequest, so players will likely encounter them at some point in the campaign. To prevent anti-trans violence in Grand Theft Auto 6, Rockstar assured Rose that players would not be able to harm Cygnus in-game.

articles.title: GTA 6 day-one sales are enormous, estimates suggest, making previous $2 billion opening weekend predictions seem conservative
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 is estimated to have sold nearly 25 million copies in one day, generating approximately $2.5bn in sales revenue - a staggering result that's beyond even what even observers were predicting.
body: The estimates come from data-tracking company Sensor Tower ( spotted by VGC ), which has been watching GTA 6 pre-orders closely for weeks, updating estimates daily based on (unspecified) data that it collects.

Should the results be accurate, it'll dramatically eclipse GTA 6's $1bn in three days result. It'll also put GTA 6 on track to reach the eye-watering $3.25bn to $5.2bn week-one sales estimates for GTA 6.

So far, Rockstar has said nothing in relation to GTA 6's sales since the game was released around the world yesterday. Parent company Take-Two has said the game's pre-orders were tracking "well above expectations, and GTA 6 broke pre-order records on both the PlayStation Store and the Xbox Store, though, so all signs point to a record-breaking release. The question is "by how much?".

Reaction to GTA 6 has been glittering. Chris awarded GTA 6 five golden stars in Eurogamer's review, calling it "a game of opposites and awe, minute detail and impossible scale". "Rockstar pushes back the horizon of video games once again with GTA 6. An irreducible mix of silliness, intimacy, grand ideas and rock 'n' roll action - and a load more after that."

articles.title: Every Future Driving Game Needs to Steal This GTA 6 Feature
articles.summary: I've written numerous times about my love for open-world driving games. I love racing, but I also love cruising, taking in the landscape, setting out on road trips. My heart belongs to Test Drive Unlimited. I've written a tourist guide for the Forza Horizon series.
body: Grand Theft Auto 6 has instantly joined my driving-game canon thanks to one tiny, but revolutionary, feature.

On the PlayStation 5 version of GTA 6, Rockstar Games has come up with a genius application for the DualSense controller's adaptive triggers. When driving, the right trigger (the throttle) provides gentle resistance when cruising at the speed limit. The effect is a sort of soft stop for the trigger; your finger rests easily there, but it's also easy to push past it when you want to put your foot down.

I cannot overstate how much I love this. If you want to cruise, you no longer need to hover your finger in an approximate spot, making tiny adjustments to try to match speed with the traffic. You can just rest it against the soft stop, the way you just rest your foot on the accelerator pedal in a real car. It's so chill.

articles.title: Sold-out Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 Is Coming Back Very Soon
articles.summary: In September 2026, Nintendo announced a new Switch 2 and controller set to commemorate the Zelda franchise's 40th anniversary and the release of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake.
body: The item's page on the Nintendo Store still lists it as sold out, but keen-eyed fans spotted a message saying that "more inventory is on the way in January 2027." This is consistent with previous statements from Nintendo that reassured fans more Zelda Switch 2 consoles were on the way.

The special-edition Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 sold out on every storefront as soon as preorders were up. The only way to get one of the consoles was to find a reseller on eBay​​​​​​​, which meant paying significantly more than the retail price. Speaking in an interview, Bill van Zyll, Nintendo’s vice president and general manager for Latin America, said the company "underestimated how well it would be received." However, he also reassured fans that Nintendo was "working on replenishments."

It doesn't hurt that the special Zelda hardware looks pretty slick, too. The controllers and the Switch 2 feature the black, gold, and green color scheme of the franchise's protagonist, Link, along with the Triforce symbol and the Hylian Crest.

articles.title: "You broke my heart" - popular artist Doja Cat gutted to not have her music in Grand Theft Auto 6
articles.summary: As countless people flock to Grand Theft Auto 6 following its launch earlier this week, a common highlight gamers have been highlighting are the many radio stations present in the game.
body: Doja Cat, a rap-pop artist and avid gamer, took to Twitter to vent about the situation. In three back-to-back posts, her thoughts were made especially clear.

Doja Cat has long been public about her love for the medium. She often streams games live on Twitch, including Fortnite, and is among the most popular Final Fantasy 14 streamers. She's also mentioned games in her songs, including a reference to Grand Theft Auto 6 in her song 'All Mine'.

Personal desires aside, having your music featured in Grand Theft Auto 6 has proven to be a rich opportunity for musicians. Tom Petty's Love is a Long Road soared by around 36 percent immediately after the release of a Grand Theft Auto 6 trailer in which it was included. So, the game acts as a spotlight on artists and their works.

Still, there is hope for Doja Cat and other artists who want their music included in the game. Rockstar Games has a history of expanding the number of songs featured on in-game radio stations post-launch as seen in Grand Theft Auto 5, so fingers crossed for the future.

articles.title: Blizzard wants to "get rid" of best-in-slot items in World of Warcraft: Forever by introducing situationally strong gear
articles.summary: With World of Warcraft: Forever's first raids set to release in early December, developers of the game have spoken about endgame itemisation and their desire to disrupt the "best-in-slot" (BIS) mindset that's been at the core of WoW's progression for years.
body: This information stems from the latest episode of the official World of Warcraft: Forever podcast. In it, senior game designer Aidan Moon revealed his philosophy around the game's itemisation, which he played - and plays - a major role in designing.

"I essentially want to get rid of BIS," Moon said. "I think BIS is not a good thing for a video game that's supposed to be about role-playing. That's why I've introduced the creature subtype system, where things are more effective against murlocs [for example]. We've introduced the biome system too, and in the raid it's different."

He gave an example from upcoming raid Barrow Deeps, which will be split into different biomes that offer opportunities for such creature subtype gear to be put to use. "If you go to the left wing that's snowy; if you go to the right wing, that's haunted; if you go down below, that's cavernous.... I think your BIS should be different for every single boss if you're making a theoretical BIS list."

articles.title: 72 Years Later, Lord of the Rings Officially Reveals Why Sauron Is So Evil
articles.summary: Sauron is one of the most famous villains of all time, but The Lord of the Rings doesn’t really explore why the Dark Lord is so obsessed with conquering all of Middle-earth.
body: Sauron is sometimes called the Great Deceiver, and his morality has seemingly shifted along with his face. He is a Maia, a cosmic being created to serve Aulë, the divine smith revered by the dwarves. But Sauron began working for the fallen Valar Morgoth and followed him to Middle-earth to serve as his chief lieutenant. When Morgoth was defeated, Sauron tried to take control of his Orc armies. Instead, Adar (Joseph Mawle), an Elf tortured and twisted by Morgoth and Sauron into becoming the progenitor of the Orcs, killed Sauron with Morgoth’s crown. It took Sauron a thousand years to put himself back together.

The humiliation not only changed his appearance but seemingly made Sauron rethink his outlook and regret some of his past misdeeds. He traveled with a group of refugees fleeing Orcs and was convinced that choosing to do good every day might make up for the evil he had done in the past. But when the refugees were attacked at sea, Sauron didn’t help. He betrayed a man that had been kind to him and stole an heirloom to create a cover story that positioned him as the lost king of the Southlands.
points: Sauron is one of the most famous villains of all time, but The Lord of the Rings doesn’t really explore why the Dark Lord is so obsessed with conquering all of Middle-earth.

articles.title: 'I've done some stupid stuff', says WoW: Forever dev who's adding unique, fun items to the game: 'There's a lot they've not seen that I'm very happy with'
articles.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever has a lot of changes from the classic version of the game, but one of the chief ones is that its items are different—and while I'm only just now starting to see actual, potential game-changing bits of kit (I've gotten into trinket-juggling between pulls), there have been…
body: In a recent episode of the official WoW: Forever podcast, senior game designer Aidan Moon spoke a little on his design philosophies, and items that players are yet to see: "There's a lot that they have not seen that I'm very happy with and I think is a great direction for the game."

Moon's entire philosophy seems built around flavour over form, using the example of the Ogre Loincloth, a pair of cloth casting pants with strength, as a north star of sorts: "I just want to do something different that adds texture and crunch to the game. People will see things like the Ogre Loincloth, and they'll be like: 'Why does this cloth thing have strength on it?'

"That's because, when we say we're a fantasy-forward game, that means that before optimisation, before it being good, it needs to be flavourful, it needs to feel like it belongs in the world and that the stats are essentially a storytelling mechanism for items."
